Prep time: 5 minutes Chill time: 30 minutes Total time: 35 minutes Number of Servings: 6 Ingredients 1/2 cup low-fat plain yogurt 3 Tablespoons 1% or nonfat milk 1 Tablespoon honey* 2 teaspoons prepared mustard (any type) Directions Wash hands with soap and water. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and stir until smooth. Cover and chill for 30 minutes before serving. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: For a stronger flavor, add an extra 1 to 2 teaspoons mustard. This recipe works with all types of mustard! *Honey is not recommended for children under 1 year old.
